name: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel
benefit: - All children residing in the hostels are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. - All hostel facilities are provided free of cost. - Children are also given a monthly stipend of ₹200/-.
_eligibility_text: Free hostel facilities are provided to boys and girls aged 6 to 18 years who: - Belong to BPL families or whose family's annual income is less than ₹55,000/-, or - Belong to SC/ST/OBC or minority communities, or - Have one or both parents deceased, or - Are children with disabilities, or - Are ragpickers, beggars, or from urban deprived and weaker sections.
